title: Correct Sage curve sampling semantics
objective: Fix constant plots, segmented discontinuities, exclusions and pole detection, fill semantics, imaginary tolerance, and true z-order while preserving stable PlotSpec intent and Sage 10.9 differential behavior.

oracles: SageMath 10.9 deterministic curve fixtures and native-disabled differential tests

handoff.summary: Implemented strict ordinary-Python Sage curve sampling and planning, a public sage.plot.plot wrapper, exact Sage 10.9 fixtures, segmented PlotSpec lowering, structured diagnostics, fill semantics, imaginary-tolerance handling, explicit sample guards, true z-order, and a phase-separated 10k/100k benchmark. Focused compiled and native-disabled suites cover constants, nonfinite midpoints, explicit exclusions, detected tan poles, endpoint singularities, fill-to-axis and fill-between-curves, symbolic and callable functions, initial points, empty lists, provenance, option rejection, and z-order independent of legend order.
risks: The isolated branch intentionally contains cherry-picked PlotSpec and primitive dependencies, so parallel:check reports those dependency-owned files as unclaimed; integrate through the primitive lane's clean superset rather than cherry-picking this branch wholesale.

The 100,000-point PlotSpec materialization median is about 7.9 seconds and only narrowly passes the temporary 8-second budget; the integration lane owns the planned flat-coordinate materialization fast path.

architecture:check currently stops at the centrally owned plot-spec lazy-package size budget (65,784 bytes over a 50,000-byte cap). The full integration tier was interrupted after widespread stale native-cache failures caused by concurrent builds; its actionable plotting failures are the centrally owned frontend surface snapshot and a primitive fixture missing default zorder=2.
Linux x64 is the only platform exercised in this lane; required Linux arm64, native Windows x64, and macOS arm64 remain integration/CI validation.
next_steps: Integrate curve-only follow-up 35fdfa66 through the primitive lane's clean post-root chain; do not import this branch's duplicate dependency history.
Raise or repartition the central plot-spec package budget, refresh the plotting surface snapshot, and update the primitive default-zorder fixture.
Apply the integration-owned flat-coordinate PlotSpec fast path, then rerun the focused benchmark and broad integration tier from a quiescent primary build.
